projection_reference_rules.prohibited_rewrite: Do not rewrite the citation to an explicit fol: target in the PL instance. Its entire FOL parent block is unselected after SAR-002.
Do not use last-definition-wins resolution to bind the unqualified source label to the alternate copy.

resolution_order: apply matching derived-only sidecar operations in memory
allocate unique literal or generated output IDs
resolve internal labels and bibliography citations
calculate package-relative links for the current profile

states.deferred: render identifying text but no broken anchor while a reserved target tranche is absent
states.external: emit a visibly external URI; the core edition must remain usable without it
states.resolved_bibliography: emit a relative link to bibliography/index.html and its bib-key anchor
states.resolved_internal: emit a relative link to the target profile and fragment
states.suppressed_by_unselected_parent: emit neither content nor link, as required by projection selection
